scope: Read-only per-file three-way merge check on the current authored PR delta; not a merge or a mergeability authorization. New candidate checked again after publication.

resolved_authoring_recheck.resolution: One-line Buddel fixture boundary decorator; preserves remote baseline semantics and main changes on standard three-way merge.
resolved_authoring_recheck.marker_count_method: Only Git marker lines at line start; test fixture string literals contain their own conflict examples.
